This matter is taken up through Hybrid arrangement (video conferencing/physical mode).
This writ petition has been filed by the petitioner, Sitamani Dey, with a prayer to direct the Zone Officer - cum- Land Acquisition Officer of Collector, Subarnarekha Irrigation Project, Laxmiposi Zone, Baripada, Mayurbhanj, opp. party no.3, for approval of the market value as per the Bench Market Value and with a further prayer to enhance the higher compensation in L.A. Case No.26 of 2018 of under section 64 of Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition,
Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013.

sentences.text:
Designation: Junior Stenographer Reason: Authentication Location: HIGH COURT OF ORISSA, CUTTACK Date: 12-Mar-2025 19:28:28 representation has been made before the Zone Officer and Land Acquisition Collector, S.I.P., Laxmiposi, Baripda,
Mayurbhanj.

However, in view of section 64 of Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013, learned counsel for the petitioner seeks permission of this Court to withdraw this writ petition and file application under section 64 before the Collector for making reference to the Authority for the determination of higher compensation.
